tenderSchedule.title: Providing Mechanized Housekeeping Services, Security Services, Gardeners and STP operator to DAS BESCOM 2027-29
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Mechanized Housekeeping Services, Security Services, Gardeners & STP operator to DAS,BESCOM Integrated Control Centers (BICC-1 & BICC-2) at HSR Layout and Rajajinagar, Bangalore
tenderSchedule.locationName: BESCOM Corporate Office DAS section Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: The General Manager ,DAS, BESCOM Integrated Control Center 1 ,17th Cross ,24th Main, Sector-2, HSR layout ,Bangalore 560102.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Any bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the bidder is registered with the competent authority.Registration certificate in the format issued by the competent authority should be uploaded.

A certificate for having read the clauses is required to be submitted/uploaded by the bidder separately in the following format.I have read the clause regarding restriction on procurement from a bidder of a country which shares a land border with India.I certify that this bidder is not from such a country or if from such a country has been registered with the competent authority.I hereby certify that this bidder fulfils all requirement in this regard and is eligible to be considered (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by competent authority should be attached.Copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- as per the format in the bid document shall be uploaded.If the Bidder from a country which shares a land with India, Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded.The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

The bidder should not have been defaulted or black listed by any Central/State Government or public sector under taking of India. Self-declaration should be uploaded. Copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- as per the format in the bid document shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

The bidder should furnish a self-declaration stating that the information/data furnished as part of their bid is true and correct. Subsequently, if it is found incorrect, such bidder will be blacklisted and further action will be initiated.Self-declaration should be uploaded.
All the terms and conditions as specified in the tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have successfully completed the work of providing manpower services to any ESCOMs/Govt departments/PSUs in the last 5 years. i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26.The total value of such services shall not be less than 50% of the Amount put to tender.Contract Order/Award issued by the concerned departments should be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Contract Order/Award issued by the concerned departments should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have provided 33 Nos of manpower services in any one of the last 5 years.i.e.,2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26 to any ESCOMs/Govt departments/PSUs.The Performance certificate issued by an officer, not below the rank of DGM/Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of ESCOMs/Govt departments/PSUs along with the completion certificate should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Performance and completion certificate should be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be in existence as any of the following.a)Company incorporated in India under the companies act1956/2013 including any amendment thereto.b)LLP incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto.c)i.Partnership Firm under Partnership Act, 1932 in India.ii.Sole Proprietorship Concern.1.Certificate of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per Companies Act 1956/2013 along with Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the Company.2.Annual filings (E Forms AOC-4 MGT-7) filed by the Company to Registrar of Companies(Ministry of Corporate Affairs,Government of India) for preceding two Financial Years.3.Declaration from Directors of the Company stating that they are not disqualified to be a Director of the Company along with the list of Companies in which they are Directors as on the date of inviting tender(s).1.Certificate of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per LLP Act 2008.2.Limited Liability Partnership Agreement of LLP.3.Form 11-Annual Return filed by LLP to Registrar of Companies(Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India) for preceding two Financial Years.1.Partnership Deed,GST Registration Certificate.Shops & Establishment Registration Certificate,as applicable.1.PAN,GST Registration Certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Incorporation certificate,AOA,MOA,Annual filings,Director declaration,LLPA,Form-11,Partnership deed,PAN,GST Registration Certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have EPF, ESI, Labour, GST and workmen compensation act registration with respective State/Central Government authorities and proof of such registration certificates should be uploaded along with the bid.a)EPF Registration certificate with Number and date.b)ESI Registration Number with date.c)Bidders PAN Card.d)GSTN registration certificate with Number and date.e)Valid labour license issued by labour department duly indicating the period of validity.Bidder should upload in the e-Procurement portal a copy of valid EPF Registration certificate, ESI registration number, PAN card, GSTN registration certificate, Valid labour license.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- valid EPF Registration certificate, ESI registration number, PAN card, GSTN registration certificate, Valid labour license should be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should furnish License/Certificate issued by Additional Director General of Police/Internal Security Division/Additional Secretary to Government and Controlling Authority(Private Security Agencies Regulation Act(PSARA)),GoK for providing security services.Valid License/Certificate should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid License/Certificate should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have achieved an annual turnover of not less than Rs.362.70 Lakhs in any two financial years out of the preceding five financial years,i.e.,FY 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26 should be uploaded.Copies of the audited Annual Accounts statements such as P&L statement, Balance sheets for the respective FYs shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have the liquid assets as on the date of issue of Notification for Inviting Tender (NIT) or later date before submission of bid consisting of Cash at Bank + Term Deposits + availability of fund based credit facility in any Nationalized/scheduled Commercial Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender i.e, Rs.90.674 Lakhs. The cash at bank, Term Deposits and the availability of fund based credit facility shall be supported by a certificate issued by any Nationalized/Scheduled Bank with whom the Bidder has banking facilities. In case of Fund based credit facility, the certificate issued by the Nationalized/Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on the date of issue of Notification for Inviting Tender (NIT) or later date before submission of bid. The balance available as on the date of issue of Notification for Inviting Tender (NIT) or later date before submission of bid shall be considered as availability of fund based credit facility. If the bidder has banking with more than one Bank, then the available liquid assets as mentioned above on a particular date i.e., as on the date of issue of Notification for Inviting Tender (NIT) or later date before submission of bid shall be the same date for all the banks.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate issued from Nationalized/scheduled Commercial Bank

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should possess the following Quality related certificates and should be valid as on the date of bid submission. a)ISO 9001:2015(Quality Management System),b)SA 8000:2014(Social Accountability System).c)ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health and Safety Management System) or OHSAS 18001-2007 Valid certificates should be uploaded in the e-procurement portal.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid certificates should be uploaded in the e-procurement portal.
